sentences.text:
By this petition, the petitioner has prayed for direction to the police Authorities for registration of
the Fir for various offences including the offence of cheating against the respondent nos. 6 to 11 on
the ground that these respondents, in spite of earning handsome income annually, which is much
more than annual income of Rs.44,000/-, have received food grains under a Government scheme,
called Priority Household Scheme.

The maximum income fixed for conferring benefits to the poor persons under the priority household scheme floated under the provisions of The National Food Security Act, 2013 and The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
It is submitted that the respondents being not poor, were not at all entitled to receive such benefits.
The petitioner claims to be a social worker interested in social cause.
The petitioner has obtained certain documents in proof of his contentions regards income earned by some respondents out of the respondent nos. 6 to 11.
These respondents belong to village Bibi and village Nanda.
